topic: When a headache means see a doctor

hook.text: Five headache red flags worth taking seriously.

beats.text: A sudden, severe headache — the worst you have ever felt — is a medical emergency. Call for help immediately.
A headache with a stiff neck, high fever, or a rash on the skin can be a sign of meningitis. Get medical help fast.
If a headache comes with sudden vision changes, weakness on one side of the body, or trouble speaking, those can be signs of a stroke. Call emergency services.
After a head injury, a headache with confusion or vomiting needs a doctor, not just rest.
A headache that gets steadily worse over days or weeks, with no clear cause, is worth bringing to your doctor.

cta: Save this. And if any of these match, talk to a doctor right away.
